claims.text: Begin by identifying and avoiding exogenous triggers: fluorinated dental products and topical glucocorticoids
claims.quote: The treatment of perioral dermatitis should begin with identification and avoidance of any exogenous triggers (eg, discontinuing the use of fluorinated dental products and topical glucocorticoids (if being used) ( 1 , 2 ).

claims.text: Abrupt corticosteroid cessation can cause rebound flaring; a gradual taper may be needed
claims.quote: Abrupt cessation of corticosteroids can cause rebound flaring; therefore, a gradual taper may be necessary.
